provenance: Merged and de-duplicated from three independent deep-research passes (Gemini, ChatGPT, Perplexity) retained in docs/research/

verification_legend.VERIFIED: Provision located in, or directly attributed to, an identified primary source.
verification_legend.UNVERIFIED: Document identified but its operative text/numbers were not retrievable. Must never be enforced as a rule.
verification_legend.HISTORICAL: Superseded edition. Retained for traceability only.

records.title: Requirements for Medical Devices Marketing Authorization (MDS-REQ1) — Classification Rule 10
records.content: Devices intended to control, monitor, or directly influence the performance of diagnostic or therapeutic ionizing-radiation equipment are classified as Class C.
records.note: الحكم المباشر على صمّام: البرمجية التي تؤثر في تشغيل جهاز أشعة تشخيصية = فئة C.

records.title: Requirements for Medical Devices Marketing Authorization (MDS-REQ1) — Classification Rule 11
records.content: Software intended to provide information used to take decisions for diagnosis or therapeutic purposes is Class B, escalating to Class C or Class D according to the potential consequence of the decision.

records.title: Guidance on Digital Health Products (MDS-G027)
records.content: Digital health products must define healthcare-professional roles and provide safeguards for human review and intervention.
records.note: الأساس النظامي لاشتراط موافقة الاستشاري في صمّام.

records.title: Guidance on AI and ML Technologies Based Medical Devices (MDS-G010)
records.content: The purpose of the MDS-G010 is to clarify the requirements for obtaining Medical Device Marketing Authorization (MDMA) for AI/ML-based medical devices to place them on the market in KSA.

records.title: Guidance on AI and ML Technologies Based Medical Devices (MDS-G010)
records.content: Manufacturers must generate evidence to demonstrate (a) a valid clinical association, (b) analytical/technical validation, and (c) clinical validation of the AI-based medical device.

records.title: Guidance on AI and ML Technologies Based Medical Devices (MDS-G010)
records.content: AI medical devices may pose risks that could jeopardize patient health and safety, increase inequalities and inefficiencies, undermine trust in healthcare, and adversely impact the management of healthcare.

records.title: Guidance on AI and ML Technologies Based Medical Devices (MDS-G010)
records.content: Requires examination of human-computer interaction, user trust and behaviour, possible undue influence by interface design, human oversight, and hand-off concepts for autonomous systems.
records.note: يغطي مباشرةً فرضية الفني المرهق — التأثير غير المبرر لتصميم الواجهة.

records.title: Guidance on AI and ML Technologies Based Medical Devices (MDS-G010)
records.content: AI medical devices shall be designed and manufactured in accordance with ISO 13485 (Medical Devices Quality Management System).

records.title: Guidance on Software as a Medical Device (MDS-G23)
records.section: Section 5.1 — Software as a Medical Device
records.content: SaMD is defined as software intended to be used for one or more medical purposes that perform these purposes without being part of a hardware medical device.

records.title: National Diagnostic Reference Levels (MDS-G008), version 2.0
records.content: A Saudi national DRL instrument titled 'National Diagnostic Reference Levels (MDS-G008), v2.0, 26 October 2022' is consistently identified in the regulatory literature. The primary SFDA PDF and its numeric CT tables were NOT recovered by any of the three research passes.
records.note: التقرير الثاني أورد أرقاماً (55.0 mGy / 950 mGy·cm للرأس، 12.0/400 للصدر، 15.0/650 للبطن والحوض، 8.0/250 لـ HRCT) لكن التقريرين الآخرين صرّحا بعدم التمكن من الوصول للـ PDF الأصلي. تُعامل الأرقام كغير موثقة.

records.title: Medical Devices Law, Royal Decree M/54
records.section: Legal basis of the MDMA framework
records.content: MDS-REQ1 expressly bases the Medical Device Marketing Authorization framework on the Medical Devices Law issued by Royal Decree M/54 and its Implementing Regulation.

records.title: ACR Manual on Contrast Media, 2026 edition
records.section: Post-Contrast Acute Kidney Injury — renal risk stratification
records.content: For stable renal function, intravenous iodinated contrast is not considered an independent nephrotoxic risk at eGFR >= 45 mL/min/1.73 m2.
records.note: عتبة إكلينيكية مهنية، وليست نصاً نظامياً سعودياً.

records.title: ACR Manual on Contrast Media, 2026 edition
records.section: Post-Contrast Acute Kidney Injury — renal risk stratification
records.content: At stable eGFR 30-44 mL/min/1.73 m2, IV iodinated contrast is either not nephrotoxic or only rarely nephrotoxic. Routine prophylaxis is not mandated, but may be considered individually when additional high-risk circumstances exist.

records.title: ACR Manual on Contrast Media, 2026 edition
records.content: Prophylactic volume expansion is indicated for acute kidney injury or severe chronic kidney disease with eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73 m2, unless the risk of fluid administration (such as heart failure or hypervolemia) outweighs the benefit. The ACR evidence review states that 30 mL/min/1.73 m2 is the best-supported threshold if a single threshold is used.
records.note: العتبة المحورية في السيناريو الثاني للديمو.

records.title: ACR Manual on Contrast Media, 2026 edition
records.content: Isotonic saline is the preferred prophylactic fluid. Typical approaches include fixed-volume regimens or approximately 1-3 mL/kg/hour; longer regimens generally provide more protection but are often operationally impractical.

records.title: ACR Manual on Contrast Media, 2026 edition
records.content: With no acute kidney injury and eGFR >= 30 mL/min/1.73 m2, ACR does not require stopping metformin for ordinary IV iodinated contrast, and does not require obligatory post-procedure renal reassessment solely for metformin.

records.title: ACR Manual on Contrast Media, 2026 edition
records.content: With acute kidney injury, eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73 m2, or specified arterial catheter procedures carrying renal embolic risk, metformin is stopped at or before the procedure, withheld for 48 hours, and restarted only after renal function is reassessed.

records.title: ESUR Contrast Media Safety Committee Guidelines 2025
records.content: The current ESUR guideline document was verified as existing and released November 2025; its renal chapter spans pp. 15-18. The numeric renal paragraphs were NOT successfully extracted during primary-source capture.

records.title: ESUR Guidelines on Contrast Agents, version 10.0
records.section: Contrast volume to renal function ratio
records.content: Version 10.0 (2018) contained an explicit contrast-volume-to-renal-function ratio. Retained here as a historical record only; it must not be implemented as a current ESUR or Saudi statutory rule.
records.note: النسبة نفسها (Volume/eGFR و g-Iodine/eGFR) وردت مبتورة في تقرير Gemini — الأرقام بعد إشارة '<' مقصوصة في الصور المصدّرة وغير قابلة للاستعادة.

records.title: eviQ / RANZCR — Risk of CI-AKI based on eGFR
records.content: > 45 mL/min/1.73 m2: risk likely non-existent. 30-45 mL/min/1.73 m2: very likely to be low or non-existent. < 30 mL/min/1.73 m2 (severe renal function impairment): highest risk of CI-AKI.
records.note: مصدر مستقل يؤكد نطاقات ACR الثلاثة — مهم لأن مصدرين متفقين أقوى من واحد.

records.title: Protocols on the Safe Use of Contrast Media in Radiology Departments
records.content: A Saudi MoH document with this exact title, Riyadh 2021, 55 pages, is confirmed by citation. The full PDF is not publicly accessible. Its eGFR thresholds, hydration protocols and metformin rules therefore CANNOT be verified from the Saudi primary source.
records.note: أهم وثيقة مفقودة في المشروع كله. الحصول عليها يحوّل كل عتبات الصبغة من مهنية دولية إلى نظامية سعودية.

records.title: Radiation Safety Regulation (NRRC-R-01)
records.content: This regulation shall be applicable to occupational, public and medical exposure in the Kingdom. The safety requirements set forth in this regulation shall apply to any person involved in activities and facilities including practices defined under the Law.

records.title: Radiation Safety Regulation (NRRC-R-01)
records.content: Chapter 12 governs Medical Exposure. Section 68 requires justification of medical exposures; Section 72 requires optimization of protection and safety. Dose limits do not apply to medical exposures of patients; control is exercised through justification, optimisation (ALARA) and Diagnostic Reference Levels.
records.note: الأساس النظامي لمطالبة صمّام بتبرير كل فحص — بما فيه اقتراح بديل غير مؤيّن.

records.title: IAEA Safety Standards GSR Part 3 / ICRP framework
records.section: Justification and optimisation of medical exposure
records.content: NRRC-R-01 formally adopts the international radiation protection framework established by IAEA Safety Standards GSR Part 3 and the ICRP. Justification requires that diagnostic efficacy outweighs stochastic radiation detriment, accounting for available non-ionizing alternatives such as MRI or ultrasound.

records.title: Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL)
records.content: Sensitive Data: Personal Data revealing racial or ethnic origin, or religious, intellectual or political belief, ... biometric or Genetic Data ... Health Data, and data that indicates that one or both of the individual's parents are unknown.

records.title: Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL)
records.content: Health Data: Any Personal Data related to an individual's health condition, whether their physical, mental or psychological conditions, or related to Health Services received by that individual.

records.title: نظام حماية البيانات الشخصية
records.content: البيانات الصحية: كل بيانات شخصية تتعلق بالحالة الصحية للفرد، سواء حالته البدنية أو العقلية أو النفسية، أو ما يتعلق بالخدمات الصحية التي تلقاها.
records.note: النص العربي الرسمي من بوابة هيئة الخبراء — أقوى مرجع للعرض أمام لجنة سعودية.

records.title: Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL)
records.content: Restricting the right to access Health Data, including medical files, to the minimum number of employees or workers ... Restricting Health Data Processing procedures and operations to the minimum extent possible of employees and workers as necessary to provide Health Services.
records.note: الأساس النظامي للسيناريو الثالث — الحظر الصارم عند محاولة تصدير بيانات المرضى.

records.title: Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL)
records.content: The Controller shall conduct an impact assessment of Personal Data Processing in relation to any product or service, based on the nature of the activity carried out by the Controller.

records.title: Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL)
records.content: There is an adequate level of protection for Personal Data outside the Kingdom ... The Transfer or Disclosure shall be limited to the minimum amount of Personal Data needed.

records.title: Implementing Regulation of the Personal Data Protection Law
records.content: The Implementing Regulation requires transparency around solely automated decisions, explicit consent in the specified automated-processing context, and DPIAs for automated or new-technology processing in the stated circumstances.
records.note: ينظّم الشفافية لا المسؤولية الطبية — وهذا جوهر الفجوة التي يرصدها المشروع.

records.title: Ethics and governance of artificial intelligence for health
records.content: The six core principles are: (1) Protect autonomy; (2) Promote human well-being, human safety, and the public interest; (3) Ensure transparency, explainability, and intelligibility; (4) Foster responsibility and accountability; (5) Ensure inclusiveness and equity; (6) Promote AI that is responsive and sustainable.

records.title: Ethics and governance of AI for health: Guidance on large multi-modal models
records.content: The principles are: (1) protect autonomy; (2) promote human well-being, human safety and the public interest; (3) ensure transparency, explainability and intelligibility; (4) foster responsibility and accountability; (5) ensure inclusiveness and equity; and (6) promote AI that is responsive and sustainable.

records.title: ITU-T Y.3172 — Architectural framework for machine learning in future networks
records.content: Defines the logical pipeline of machine-learning nodes: Source, Collector, Preprocessor, Model, Policy, Distributor and Sink. The Policy node applies operator-defined constraints to model output before it reaches the sink.

gaps.title: لا توجد عتبة eGFR سعودية نظامية
gaps.finding: القيمتان 30 و 45 mL/min/1.73m² موثقتان دولياً (ACR 2026، RANZCR/eviQ) لكن لا يوجد نص سعودي أولي يقرّهما. بروتوكول وزارة الصحة 2021 مؤكد بعنوانه فقط ولم يُتَح نصه.
gaps.implication: صمّام لا يجوز أن يعرض الحجب كـ«مخالفة نظام سعودي». يعرضه كـ«قاعدة إكلينيكية معتمدة مؤسسياً — ACR 2026» مع إظهار المصدر والإصدار في سجل القرار.
gaps.recommendation: إلزام أنظمة دعم القرار بتسجيل مصدر كل عتبة وإصدارها (rule provenance)، وإصدار وزارة الصحة بروتوكولاً وطنياً منشوراً يحسم القيم.

gaps.title: المسؤولية عند قبول فني مرهق لتوصية آلية
gaps.finding: نظام SFDA يشترط دراسة تفاعل الإنسان والحاسب والتأثير غير المبرر لتصميم الواجهة وآليات الرقابة البشرية، لكنه لا يحدد على من تقع المسؤولية عند وقوع الضرر.
gaps.implication: أقوى فجوة في المشروع — تربط فكرة فيصل (الاحتراق الوظيفي) بفراغ تشريعي حقيقي موثق.
gaps.recommendation: نص يوزّع المسؤولية بين المصنّع والمنشأة والفني والاستشاري، ويشترط توقيعاً رقمياً موثقاً قبل تجاوز أي تنبيه أمان.

gaps.title: لا توجد قيم DRL سعودية متاحة للتحقق
gaps.finding: MDS-G008 موثقة كأداة وطنية للمستويات المرجعية التشخيصية، لكن الـ PDF وجداول الـ CT لم تُستَرجع في أي من الأبحاث الثلاثة.
gaps.implication: لا يجوز لصمّام أن يحجب بناءً على تجاوز DRL سعودي، لأننا لا نملك القيم موثقة.
gaps.recommendation: نشر MDS-G008 كبيانات مفتوحة قابلة للقراءة الآلية.

gaps.title: لا سقف تراكمي لجرعة مرضى الأورام
gaps.finding: لا يوجد نص سعودي يضع حداً تراكمياً لجرعة الأشعة للمرضى الذين يُصوَّرون تكراراً في المتابعة الأورامية.
gaps.implication: مبدأ التبرير يُطبَّق لكل فحص على حدة، ولا يغطي التراكم عبر رحلة العلاج.
gaps.recommendation: إضافة اشتراط تتبع الجرعة التراكمية في السجل الصحي الموحد.

gaps.title: التحكم الآلي بالجهاز منظَّم أكثر من المساءلة الإكلينيكية
gaps.finding: القاعدة 10 لدى SFDA تصنّف بوضوح البرمجيات المؤثرة في أجهزة الأشعة كفئة C، لكن لا يوجد نص يفرض تأكيد الطبيب قبل تعديل kVp/mAs أو جرعة الصبغة، ولا يحدد حدود التشغيل الذاتي المسموح بها، ولا يوثّق المسؤولية عند تجاهل التنبيهات.
gaps.implication: المسار التنظيمي لتسجيل صمّام واضح؛ الغائب هو طبقة الحوكمة التشغيلية.
gaps.recommendation: لائحة تشغيلية تُلزم بتسجيل كل تجاوز (override) وربطه بهوية المعتمِد.

gaps.title: قانون البيانات ليس قانون الأخطاء الطبية
gaps.finding: اللائحة التنفيذية لنظام حماية البيانات تعالج شفافية القرارات الآلية، لكنها لا تحدد هل يجوز للطبيب أو الفني تفويض الحكم الإكلينيكي لنظام آلي، ولا من يتحمل التعويض عند الخطأ.
gaps.implication: الاعتماد على PDPL وحده لتبرير سلامة النظام الطبي خطأ منهجي.
gaps.recommendation: تكامل صريح بين نظام حماية البيانات وأنظمة المهن الصحية.
